source.name: Structure of the O*NET Work Importance Locator / Minnesota Importance Questionnaire (6 values, 21 needs)
source.license: Value/need taxonomy is public (O*NET content model). Card wording is anaBokra's own and must be reviewed by the psychologist.
source.notes: Each need card maps to one of the six O*NET work values so results connect directly to O*NET occupation data. 'Must have' is limited to 7 cards to force prioritization, as in the original Q-sort. The 'budget' is a quicker alternative used in Discover/Verify (10 coins over the six values, one screen); a session uses one or the other (apps/web ANSWER_FORMATS). DRAFT: the psychologist confirms the budget and its scoring before the pilot.

text.en: I'd use my abilities to the fullest
I'd feel a sense of accomplishment
I'd be busy all the time
I'd do my work alone
I'd do something different every day
I'd earn more than most people
I'd have a stable, secure job
I'd have good working conditions
I'd have chances to get promoted
I'd get recognition for my work
I'd direct and lead others
I'd be looked up to in my community
text.ar: يكون ليا مكانة واحترام في المجتمع

text.en: My coworkers would be easy to get along with
text.ar: زمايلي يكونوا لطاف وسهل أتعامل معاهم

text.en: I'd do things that help other people
I'd never be pushed to act against my values
text.ar: محدش يضغط عليا أعمل حاجة ضد قيمي

text.en: The organization would treat workers fairly
My manager would back me up
My manager would train me well
I'd try out my own ideas
I'd make decisions on my own
I'd plan my work with little supervision
text.ar: أخطط لشغلي من غير رقابة كتير
